source.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ׀לְעֶ֥בֶד יְהוָ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּ֨ר׀לַיהוָ֗ה אֶת־דִּ֭בְרֵי הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּי֤וֹם הִֽצִּיל־יְהוָ֘ה אוֹת֥וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל־אֹ֝יְבָ֗יו וּמִיַּ֥ד שָׁאֽוּל׃

records.literal_gloss: For the director. Of [the] servant of YHWH, of David, who spoke to YHWH the words of this song on [the] day YHWH delivered him from [the] palm of all his enemies and from [the] hand of Saul.

en.L: For the director: of the servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, of David, who spoke to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the words of this song on the day [when] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} delivered him from the palm of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
en.B: For the music director. By David, the servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He sang the words of this song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on the day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rescued him from the power of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
en.R: For the leader of the music. By David, who served {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He sang this song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} saved him from all his enemies, and from Saul.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : du serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, de David, qui adressa {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} les paroles de ce cantique le jour [où] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le délivra de la paume de tous ses ennemis et de la main de Saül.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. De David, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il chanta les paroles de ce cantique {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} le jour où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le délivra du pouvoir de tous ses ennemis et de la main de Saül.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. De David, qui servait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il a chanté ce chant {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a sauvé de tous ses ennemis, et de Saül.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: ya mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ya Daudi, aliyemwambia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} maneno ya wimbo huu siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipomwokoa kutoka katika kiganja cha adui zake wote na kutoka mkononi mwa Sauli.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Ya Daudi, mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Alimwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} maneno ya wimbo huu siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipomwokoa kutoka katika mamlaka ya adui zake wote na kutoka mkononi mwa Sauli.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Ya Daudi, aliyemtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Alimwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo huu wakati {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipomwokoa kutoka kwa adui zake wote, na kutoka kwa Sauli.

es.L: Al director del coro: del siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, de David, que dijo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} las palabras de este cántico el día [en que] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo libró de la palma de todos sus enemigos y de la mano de Saúl.
es.B: Al director del coro. De David, siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Él cantó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} las palabras de este cántico el día en que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo rescató del poder de todos sus enemigos y de la mano de Saúl.
es.R: Para el director de la música. De David, que servía {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Le cantó este canto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo salvó de todos sus enemigos y de Saúl.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the same song as 2 Samuel 22
decisions.reason: With small differences, this psalm is the song David sings in 2 Samuel 22, which has a shorter title of the same kind. Its setting is the end of David's wars, when Saul was dead and the LORD had given him rest from his enemies.

decisions.choice: the servant of the LORD: a title of honor
decisions.reason: "Servant of the LORD" is the title of Moses (Deuteronomy 34:5) and Joshua (Joshua 24:29). It is given to David here and in the title of Psalm 36.

decisions.choice: the palm of all his enemies: their power
decisions.reason: The palm and the hand stand for power and control.

decisions.choice: the director
decisions.reason: As in 4:1.

decisions.choice: "le serviteur du SEIGNEUR" at Literal as well as Balanced
decisions.reason: The rule for these books is "esclave" at Literal for ʿeved, but here the phrase is a title of honor (m3), given to Moses, Joshua and David, and the English Literal too says "servant". "Esclave" would read as a status of shame. Readable says what the title means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ce cantique" (Literal, Balanced), "ce chant" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Shir, "song", is "cantique" at Literal and Balanced and "chant" at Readable, as the terms note sets for the titles.

decisions.choice: "mtumishi wa BWANA" at Literal and Balanced; "aliyemtumikia BWANA" (who served the LORD) at Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew ʿeved is a slave or servant; "the servant of the LORD" is a title of honor (m3). In the Psalms Swahili says "mtumishi" for ʿeved at every level, Literal included, for God's servants and the psalmist's name for himself; "mtumwa" is kept for slavery itself (Joseph sold, 105:17; the slaves of 123:2).

decisions.choice: siervo
decisions.reason: The Hebrew ʿeved is "slave" or "servant". Here "the servant of the LORD" is a title of honor given to Moses, Joshua and David, so Spanish says "siervo" (Readable: "que servía al SEÑOR") rather than "esclavo", which Literal uses where the word means a slave.

decisions.choice: cántico (L, B); canto (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew shir is a song. Literal and Balanced say "cántico", Readable "canto", as in the other psalm titles.

source.text: וַיֹּאמַ֡ר אֶרְחָמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חִזְקִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, I love you, YHWH, my strength.

en.L: And he said: "I love {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, my strength.
en.B: He said: "I love {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, my strength.
en.R: He said: "{{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I love {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. You make me strong.

fr.L: Et il dit : « Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}aime, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ma force.
fr.B: Il dit : « Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}aime, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ma force.
fr.R: Il a dit : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}aime. C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui me rends fort.

sw.L: Akasema: "Ninakupenda, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nguvu yangu.
sw.B: Alisema: "Ninakupenda, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nguvu yangu.
sw.R: Alisema: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninakupenda. Wewe unanipa nguvu.

es.L: Y dijo: «Te amo, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, fuerza mía.
es.B: Él dijo: «Yo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} amo, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, mi fuerza.
es.R: Dijo: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, yo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} amo. Tú me haces fuerte.

decisions.choice: I love you: a love deep within
decisions.reason: The verb (racham) is used of the tender love of a parent for a child (103:13); only here is it used of a person's love for God. The line is not in 2 Samuel 22.

decisions.choice: the song as one speech
decisions.reason: The whole song, to verse 51, is David's speech; the quotation opens here and closes at the end of the psalm.

decisions.choice: You make me strong
decisions.reason: Readable turns the title into a sentence.

source.text: יְהוָ֤ה׀סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִ֗י וּמְפַ֫לְטִ֥י אֵלִ֣י צ֭וּרִי אֶֽחֱסֶה־בּ֑וֹ מָֽגִנִּ֥י וְקֶֽרֶן־יִ֝שְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH [is] my rock and my stronghold and my deliverer, my God, my rock, I take refuge in him, my shield and [the] horn of my salvation, my high refuge.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] my crag and my stronghold and my deliverer, my God, my rock in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my high refuge.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is my cliff, my stronghold, the one who sets me free; my God is my rock, and I shelter in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He is my shield, my strong salvation, my tower on the heights.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is like a high rock where I am safe. He is like a fort, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rescues me. My God is like a rock where I can run for safety. He protects me like a shield. He is strong to save me. He is like a tower high above my enemies.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] mon roc et ma forteresse et mon libérateur, mon Dieu, mon rocher en qui je me réfugie, mon bouclier et la corne de mon salut, mon haut refuge.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est ma falaise, ma forteresse, celui qui me libère ; mon Dieu est mon rocher, et je m’abrite en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il est mon bouclier, mon salut puissant, ma tour sur les hauteurs.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est comme un haut rocher où je suis en sécurité. Il est comme une forteresse, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me délivre. Mon Dieu est comme un rocher où je peux courir me mettre à l’abri. Il me protège comme un bouclier. Il est assez fort pour me sauver. Il est comme une tour, bien au-dessus de mes ennemis.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] jabali langu na ngome yangu na mwokozi wangu, Mungu wangu, mwamba wangu ninayemkimbilia, ngao yangu na pembe ya wokovu wangu, kimbilio langu la juu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni jabali langu, ngome yangu, yule anayeniweka huru; Mungu wangu ni mwamba wangu, nami ninajificha {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Yeye ni ngao yangu, wokovu wangu wenye nguvu, mnara wangu juu milimani.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni kama mwamba mrefu ambapo niko salama. Yeye ni kama ngome, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ananiokoa. Mungu wangu ni kama mwamba ninaoweza kuukimbilia ili niwe salama. Ananilinda kama ngao. Ana nguvu za kuniokoa. Yeye ni kama mnara ulio juu sana, mbali na adui zangu.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] mi peña y mi fortaleza y mi libertador, mi Dios, mi roca en quien me refugio, mi escudo y el cuerno de mi salvación, mi alto refugio.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es mi peñasco, mi fortaleza, el que me libera; mi Dios es mi roca, y en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me refugio. Él es mi escudo, mi poderosa salvación, mi torre en las alturas.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es como una roca alta donde estoy a salvo. Es como una fortaleza, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me rescata. Mi Dios es como una roca adonde puedo correr para estar a salvo. Me protege como un escudo. Él es fuerte para salvarme. Es como una torre muy por encima de mis enemigos.

decisions.choice: rock, stronghold, high refuge: places of safety in the hills
decisions.reason: David hid from Saul in the rocky heights and strongholds of the wilderness (1 Samuel 23:14, 25). The words for these places (sela', metsudah, misgav) become names for God himself.

decisions.choice: the horn of my salvation: my strong savior
decisions.reason: A horn is the strength of an animal and so a picture of power (75:11; 1 Samuel 2:1); "the horn of my salvation" is the power that saves me.

decisions.choice: I take refuge in him
decisions.reason: As in 7:2.

decisions.choice: my strong salvation (B); He is strong to save me (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the horn means (m2).

decisions.choice: like a high rock, like a fort, like a tower
decisions.reason: Readable makes the pictures comparisons, so that young readers do not take them literally.

decisions.choice: "jabali" for the crag (selaʿ), "mwamba" for the rock (tsur), "ngome" for the stronghold, "kimbilio la juu" for the high refuge
decisions.reason: The song piles up words for high, safe places in the hills (m1). Swahili keeps two words for the two Hebrew rocks, so that the list does not repeat itself; "mwamba" is kept for tsur, the word used for God as "my rock" through the Psalms.

decisions.choice: peña (L), peñasco (B); roca
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has two words for rock here, selaʿ, a high crag, and tsur, a rock. Literal and Balanced keep them apart, "peña" or "peñasco" and "roca", as the English keeps "crag" or "cliff" and "rock".

source.text: מְ֭הֻלָּל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמִן־אֹ֝יְבַ֗י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The one who is] to be praised I call [on], YHWH, and from my enemies I am saved.

en.L: [The one who is] worthy of praise I call [on], {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and from my enemies I am saved.
en.B: I call on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who is worthy of praise, and from my enemies I am rescued.
en.R: I call to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who deserves all praise, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saves me from my enemies.

fr.L: [Celui qui est] digne de louange, je [l’]invoque, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et de mes ennemis je suis sauvé.
fr.B: J’invoque {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui est digne de louange, et je suis délivré de mes ennemis.
fr.R: J’appelle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui mérite toutes les louanges, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me sauve de mes ennemis.

sw.L: [Yeye astahiliye] kusifiwa ninamwita, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nami ninaokolewa kutoka kwa adui zangu.
sw.B: Ninamwita {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, anayestahili kusifiwa, nami ninaokolewa kutoka kwa adui zangu.
sw.R: Ninamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, anayestahili sifa zote, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ananiokoa kutoka kwa adui zangu.

es.L: [Al que es] digno de alabanza invoco, {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y de mis enemigos soy salvado.
es.B: Invoco {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, que es digno de alabanza, y soy rescatado de mis enemigos.
es.R: Clamo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, que merece toda alabanza, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me salva de mis enemigos.

decisions.choice: I call, I am saved: what always happens
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the unfinished form: whenever David calls, he is saved. Verses 5-20 then tell one great rescue.

decisions.choice: the one to be praised: worthy of praise
decisions.reason: The word (mehullal) means praised, deserving praise (48:2; 96:4).

source.text: אֲפָפ֥וּנִי חֶבְלֵי־מָ֑וֶת וְֽנַחֲלֵ֖י בְלִיַּ֣עַל יְבַֽעֲתֽוּנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: They encompassed me, [the] cords of death, and torrents of worthlessness terrified me.

en.L: The cords of death encompassed me, and torrents of destruction terrified me.
en.B: Death's ropes were wrapped around me; floods of ruin overwhelmed me with terror.
en.R: Death was like ropes tied around me. Danger poured over me like a flood, and I was terrified.

fr.L: Les liens de la mort m’ont enveloppé, et les torrents de la destruction m’ont épouvanté.
fr.B: Les cordes de la mort s’étaient enroulées autour de moi ; des flots de ruine m’avaient rempli de terreur.
fr.R: La mort était comme des cordes attachées autour de moi. Le danger déferlait sur moi comme une inondation, et j’étais terrifié.

sw.L: Kamba za mauti zilinizunguka, na mafuriko ya maangamizi yalinitia hofu.
sw.B: Kamba za kifo zilinifunga pande zote; mafuriko ya uharibifu yalinilemea kwa hofu.
sw.R: Kifo kilikuwa kama kamba zilizonifunga. Hatari ilinimwagikia kama mafuriko, nami nikaogopa sana.

es.L: Me rodearon las cuerdas de la muerte, y torrentes de destrucción me aterrorizaron.
es.B: Las sogas de la muerte se enredaron a mi alrededor; ríos de ruina me llenaron de terror.
es.R: La muerte era como sogas atadas a mi alrededor. El peligro me cubrió como una inundación, y yo estaba aterrado.

decisions.choice: cords: ropes, or birth pangs
decisions.reason: The word (chevel) means a rope or a pain of childbirth; with "snares" in verse 6 it means ropes. 2 Samuel 22:5 has "the breakers of death".

decisions.choice: worthlessness: ruin, destruction
decisions.reason: The word (beliyya'al) means what is worthless and destructive; it later became a name for evil and for Satan (2 Corinthians 6:15).

decisions.choice: torrents: death pictured as a flood
decisions.reason: The waters of death rise and sweep the singer away, as in 69:2-3; God draws him out in verse 17.

source.text: חֶבְלֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל סְבָב֑וּנִי קִ֝דְּמ֗וּנִי מ֣וֹקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] cords of Sheol surrounded me; [the] snares of death confronted me.

en.L: The cords of Sheol surrounded me; the snares of death confronted me.
en.B: The ropes of Sheol coiled around me; death's traps lay right in front of me.
en.R: It was as if the place of the dead had me tied up. Death had set traps for me, and I could not get away.

fr.L: Les liens du Shéol m’ont entouré ; les pièges de la mort se sont dressés devant moi.
fr.B: Les cordes du séjour des morts s’enroulaient autour de moi ; les pièges de la mort étaient juste devant moi.
fr.R: C’était comme si le séjour des morts m’avait ligoté. La mort m’avait tendu des pièges, et je ne pouvais pas m’échapper.

sw.L: Kamba za Kuzimu zilinizunguka; mitego ya mauti ilinikabili.
sw.B: Kamba za Kuzimu zilinizingira; mitego ya kifo ilikuwa mbele yangu kabisa.
sw.R: Ilikuwa kana kwamba Kuzimu ilinifunga kwa kamba. Kifo kilikuwa kimeniwekea mitego, nami sikuweza kutoroka.

es.L: Las cuerdas del Seol me rodearon; los lazos de la muerte me salieron al encuentro.
es.B: Las sogas del lugar de los muertos se enroscaron a mi alrededor; las trampas de la muerte estaban justo delante de mí.
es.R: Era como si el lugar de los muertos me tuviera atado. La muerte me había puesto trampas, y yo no podía escapar.

decisions.choice: Sheol: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: As in 6:6.

decisions.choice: the snares of death confronted me: death stood in my way
decisions.reason: Death is a hunter whose traps meet the singer at every turn (116:3).

source.text: בַּצַּר־לִ֤י׀אֶֽקְרָ֣א יְהוָה֮ וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַ֪י אֲשַׁ֫וֵּ֥עַ יִשְׁמַ֣ע מֵהֵיכָל֣וֹ קוֹלִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֤יו׀תָּב֬וֹא בְאָזְנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: In my distress I called [on] YHWH, and to my God I cried for help; he heard from his temple my voice, and my cry before him came into his ears.

en.L: In my distress I called [on] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and to my God I cried for help; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} heard my voice from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple, and my cry before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} came into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ears.
en.B: When I was hard pressed I called on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and cried out to my God. Out of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} listened to my voice; my cry came before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and reached {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ears.
en.R: When I was in trouble, I called out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I begged my God to help me. He was in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} heard me. My cry reached {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ears.

fr.L: Dans ma détresse j’ai invoqué {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et vers mon Dieu j’ai crié au secours ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a entendu ma voix de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple, et mon cri devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} est parvenu à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} oreilles.
fr.B: Quand j’étais acculé, j’ai invoqué {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et j’ai crié vers mon Dieu. De {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a écouté ma voix ; mon cri est venu devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et a atteint {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} oreilles.
fr.R: Quand j’étais dans le malheur, j’ai appelé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. J’ai supplié mon Dieu de m’aider. Il était dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a entendu. Mon cri est arrivé jusqu’à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} oreilles.

sw.L: Katika dhiki yangu nilimwita {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na kwa Mungu wangu nililia kuomba msaada; alisikia sauti yangu kutoka hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, na kilio changu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kiliingia masikioni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}.
sw.B: Nilipobanwa sana nilimwita {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumlilia Mungu wangu. Kutoka hekaluni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}} aliisikiliza sauti yangu; kilio changu kilifika mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na kuingia masikioni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}.
sw.R: Nilipokuwa taabuni, nilimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nilimsihi Mungu wangu anisaidie. Alikuwa katika hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akanisikia. Kilio changu kilifika masikioni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}.

es.L: En mi angustia invoqué {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y a mi Dios clamé por ayuda; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} oyó mi voz desde {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo, y mi clamor delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} llegó a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} oídos.
es.B: Cuando estaba en aprietos, invoqué {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y clamé a mi Dios. Desde {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escuchó mi voz; mi clamor llegó delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y alcanzó {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} oídos.
es.R: Cuando estaba en problemas, clamé {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Le rogué a mi Dios que me ayudara. Él estaba en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me oyó. Mi clamor llegó a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} oídos.

decisions.choice: his temple: God's dwelling in heaven
decisions.reason: As in 11:4, the temple is God's palace in heaven, from which he comes down in verses 8-16.

decisions.choice: I called, he heard: the story of the rescue
decisions.reason: Here the song turns to tell the rescue as a past event.

decisions.choice: the story of the rescue (verses 7-20) in the passé composé at every level
alternatives: the passé simple at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The whole song is spoken to God and about him (m2 of verse 2), so even the story it tells keeps the tenses of speech, as stories told inside speeches do elsewhere in this translation.

source.text: וַתִּגְעַ֬שׁ וַתִּרְעַ֨שׁ׀הָאָ֗רֶץ וּמוֹסְדֵ֣י הָרִ֣ים יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַ֝יִּתְגָּֽעֲשׁ֗וּ כִּי־חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And shook and quaked the earth, and [the] foundations of [the] mountains trembled and shook, for it burned to him.

en.L: And the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled and shook, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was angry.
en.B: Then the earth shuddered and rocked; the roots of the mountains trembled and were shaken, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was furious.
en.R: Then the earth shook. Even the mountains shook to their roots, because God was very angry.

fr.L: Et la terre a tremblé et vacillé, et les fondements des montagnes ont frémi et ont été ébranlés, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était en colère.
fr.B: Alors la terre a frissonné et chancelé ; les racines des montagnes ont tremblé, ébranlées, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était furieux.
fr.R: Alors la terre a tremblé. Même les montagnes ont tremblé jusqu’à leurs racines, parce que Dieu était très en colère.

sw.L: Ndipo nchi ikatikisika na kutetemeka, na misingi ya milima ikatetemeka na kutikiswa, kwa maana alikuwa amekasirika.
sw.B: Kisha dunia ikatetemeka na kuyumba; mizizi ya milima ikatetemeka na kutikiswa, kwa sababu alikuwa amekasirika sana.
sw.R: Kisha dunia ikatikisika. Hata milima ikatikisika mpaka mizizi yake, kwa sababu Mungu alikuwa amekasirika sana.

es.L: Y la tierra se sacudió y tembló, y los cimientos de los montes se estremecieron y se sacudieron, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estaba enojado.
es.B: Entonces la tierra se estremeció y se tambaleó; las raíces de los montes temblaron y se sacudieron, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estaba furioso.
es.R: Entonces la tierra tembló. Hasta las montañas temblaron desde sus raíces, porque Dios estaba muy enojado.

decisions.choice: the earth shook: the LORD comes as at Sinai
decisions.reason: Verses 8-16 picture the LORD coming down in storm and earthquake, as he did at Mount Sinai (Exodus 19:16-18) and when he led Israel out of Egypt (Judges 5:4-5; 68:8-9).

decisions.choice: it burned to him: he was angry
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "it burned to him", a common way of saying that anger flared up (Genesis 4:5).

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names who was angry.

source.text: עָ֘לָ֤ה עָשָׁ֨ן׀בְּאַפּ֗וֹ וְאֵשׁ־מִפִּ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּ֝חָלִ֗ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Smoke went up in his nose, and fire from his mouth devoured; coals burned from it.

en.L: Smoke went up from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} nostrils, and fire from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mouth devoured; coals blazed from it.
en.B: Smoke rose from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} nostrils, and fire that consumes came from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mouth; burning coals flamed out of it.
en.R: Smoke came out of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} nose. Fire that burns up everything came out of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mouth, with red-hot coals.

fr.L: Une fumée est montée de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} narines, et un feu de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bouche dévorait ; des braises en jaillissaient enflammées.
fr.B: La fumée s’élevait de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} narines, et un feu dévorant sortait de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bouche ; des charbons ardents en jaillissaient.
fr.R: De la fumée est sortie de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nez. Un feu qui brûle tout est sorti de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bouche, avec des braises rouges.

sw.L: Moshi ulipanda kutoka puani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}, na moto kutoka kinywani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}} ukala; makaa yaliwaka kutokana nao.
sw.B: Moshi ulipanda kutoka puani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}, na moto unaoteketeza ukatoka kinywani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}; makaa yanayowaka yakatoka ndani yake.
sw.R: Moshi ulitoka puani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}. Moto unaoteketeza kila kitu ukatoka kinywani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}, pamoja na makaa ya moto mekundu.

es.L: Subió humo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nariz, y fuego de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} boca devoraba; brasas ardían de él.
es.B: Salió humo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nariz, y de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} boca un fuego que consume; carbones encendidos salían de ella.
es.R: Salió humo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nariz. De {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} boca salió un fuego que lo quema todo, con brasas al rojo vivo.

decisions.choice: smoke in his nose: a picture of anger
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the nose is the seat of anger (the word 'af means both); the snorting of fury is pictured as smoke and fire.

decisions.choice: fire from his mouth: God's holy anger
decisions.reason: The LORD is a consuming fire (Deuteronomy 4:24). The picture is poetry for God's power against those who oppose him.

source.text: וַיֵּ֣ט שָׁ֭מַיִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he bent [the] heavens and came down, and thick darkness [was] under his feet.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} bent the heavens and came down, and thick darkness [was] under {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet.
en.B: He bowed the heavens low and came down; storm clouds were dark beneath {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet.
en.R: He opened the sky and came down. Dark clouds were under {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a incliné les cieux et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est descendu, et une épaisse obscurité [était] sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds.
fr.B: Il a abaissé les cieux et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est descendu ; des nuées d’orage sombres étaient sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds.
fr.R: Il a ouvert le ciel et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est descendu. Des nuages noirs étaient sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds.

sw.L: Akaziinamisha mbingu akashuka, na giza nene [lilikuwa] chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Aliziinamisha mbingu chini akashuka; mawingu meusi ya dhoruba yalikuwa chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Alifungua anga akashuka. Mawingu meusi yalikuwa chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} inclinó los cielos y descendió, y oscuridad densa [había] debajo de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies.
es.B: Bajó los cielos y descendió; bajo {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies había oscuras nubes de tormenta.
es.R: Abrió el cielo y bajó. Había nubes oscuras debajo de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies.

decisions.choice: bent the heavens: bowed the sky down
decisions.reason: The verb (natah) means to stretch out or bend; the sky bows down as God comes (144:5).

decisions.choice: thick darkness: the dark cloud around God
decisions.reason: The thick darkness ('arafel) is the cloud in which God came to Sinai (Exodus 20:21; Deuteronomy 4:11).

source.text: וַיִּרְכַּ֣ב עַל־כְּ֭רוּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַ֝יֵּ֗דֶא עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רֽוּחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he rode on a cherub and flew, and swooped on [the] wings of [the] wind.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rode on a cherub and flew, and swooped on the wings of the wind.
en.B: Riding on a cherub, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} flew; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} swooped down on the wings of the wind.
en.R: He flew, riding on a cherub. He came down fast, carried by the wind.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est monté sur un chérubin et a volé, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fondu sur les ailes du vent.
fr.B: Monté sur un chérubin, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a pris {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} vol ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fondu sur les ailes du vent.
fr.R: Il a volé, monté sur un chérubin. Il est descendu très vite, porté par le vent.

sw.L: Akapanda juu ya kerubi akaruka, na akashuka kwa kasi juu ya mabawa ya upepo.
sw.B: Akiwa amepanda kerubi, aliruka; alishuka kwa kasi juu ya mabawa ya upepo.
sw.R: Aliruka akiwa amepanda kerubi. Alishuka kwa kasi, akibebwa na upepo.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cabalgó sobre un querubín y voló, y se lanzó sobre las alas del viento.
es.B: Montado sobre un querubín, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} voló; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se lanzó sobre las alas del viento.
es.R: Voló, montado en un querubín. Bajó rápidamente, llevado por el viento.

decisions.choice: a cherub: a winged being who serves God
decisions.reason: Cherubim guard God's presence (Genesis 3:24) and carry his throne (Ezekiel 10); the LORD is "enthroned on the cherubim" (80:2; 1 Samuel 4:4). Here a cherub is his chariot.

decisions.choice: swooped: flew swiftly down
decisions.reason: The verb (da'ah) is used of a bird of prey swooping (Deuteronomy 28:49); 2 Samuel 22:11 has a similar-looking word meaning "was seen".

source.text: יָ֤שֶׁת חֹ֨שֶׁךְ׀סִתְר֗וֹ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֥יו סֻכָּת֑וֹ חֶשְׁכַת־מַ֝֗יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: He made darkness his hiding place around him, his canopy darkness of waters, clouds of skies.

en.L: He made darkness {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hiding place, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} canopy around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, dark waters, clouds of the skies.
en.B: He wrapped {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} in darkness and hid in it; all around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} was a tent of dark rain clouds, thick clouds of the sky.
en.R: He hid {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} in darkness. He was covered with dark rain clouds like a tent.

fr.L: Il a fait de l’obscurité {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} cachette, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} tente autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, eaux sombres, nuées des cieux.
fr.B: Il {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}est enveloppé d’obscurité et {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}y est caché ; tout autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, une tente de sombres nuages de pluie, d’épaisses nuées du ciel.
fr.R: Il {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}est caché dans l’obscurité. Des nuages de pluie sombres {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} couvraient comme une tente.

sw.L: Alilifanya giza kuwa maficho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kibanda {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} kumzunguka, maji yenye giza, mawingu ya anga.
sw.B: Alijifunika gizani na kujificha ndani yake; pande zote {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} palikuwa na hema la mawingu meusi ya mvua, mawingu mazito ya anga.
sw.R: Alijificha gizani. Alifunikwa na mawingu meusi ya mvua kama hema.

es.L: Hizo de la oscuridad {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} escondite, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pabellón alrededor de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, aguas oscuras, nubes de los cielos.
es.B: Se envolvió en oscuridad y se escondió en ella; a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} alrededor había una tienda de oscuras nubes de lluvia, densas nubes del cielo.
es.R: Se escondió en la oscuridad. Estaba cubierto de nubes oscuras de lluvia, como una tienda.

decisions.choice: his canopy: his tent or booth
decisions.reason: The word (sukkah) is a shelter or booth; the storm clouds are God's tent (Job 36:29).

decisions.choice: darkness of waters: dark rain clouds
decisions.reason: Clouds heavy with water are dark; the storm hides God from sight (97:2).

source.text: מִנֹּ֗גַהּ נֶ֫גְדּ֥וֹ עָבָ֥יו עָבְר֑וּ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: From [the] brightness before him his clouds passed, hail and coals of fire.

en.L: From the brightness before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} clouds passed through, hail and coals of fire.
en.B: Out of the brightness in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} clouds broke through, with hail and burning coals.
en.R: From the bright light around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, hail and burning coals burst out of the clouds.

fr.L: De l’éclat devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} nuées ont passé, grêle et braises de feu.
fr.B: De l’éclat qui était devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} nuées ont percé, avec de la grêle et des charbons ardents.
fr.R: De la lumière éclatante autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, la grêle et des braises ont jailli des nuages.

sw.L: Kutoka katika mwangaza ulio mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mawingu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yalipita, mvua ya mawe na makaa ya moto.
sw.B: Kutoka katika mwangaza ulio mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mawingu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yalipasuka, pamoja na mvua ya mawe na makaa yanayowaka.
sw.R: Kutoka katika nuru angavu iliyomzunguka, mvua ya mawe na makaa yanayowaka yalitoka mawinguni kwa nguvu.

es.L: Por el resplandor delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} nubes pasaron, granizo y carbones de fuego.
es.B: Del resplandor que había delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} nubes se abrieron paso, con granizo y brasas ardientes.
es.R: De la luz brillante que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} rodeaba, salieron de las nubes granizo y brasas ardientes.

decisions.choice: brightness: the light around God
decisions.reason: The brightness (nogah) is the blazing light of God's presence (Ezekiel 1:4, 28).

decisions.choice: hail and coals of fire: hail and lightning
decisions.reason: As in the plague on Egypt, hail falls with fire (Exodus 9:23-24); the "coals of fire" are lightning.

source.text: וַיַּרְעֵ֬ם בַּשָּׁמַ֨יִם׀יְֽהוָ֗ה וְ֭עֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן קֹל֑וֹ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And thundered in the heavens YHWH, and [the] Most High gave his voice, hail and coals of fire.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} thundered in the heavens, and the Most High gave forth {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice, hail and coals of fire.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} thundered in the heavens; the Most High raised {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice, with hail and burning coals.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} thundered from the sky. The God who is above all spoke with a voice like thunder. Hail and burning coals came down.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a tonné dans les cieux, et le Très-Haut a fait retentir {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix, grêle et braises de feu.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a tonné dans les cieux ; le Très-Haut a élevé {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix, avec de la grêle et des charbons ardents.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait gronder le tonnerre dans le ciel. Le Dieu qui est au-dessus de tout a parlé d’une voix de tonnerre. La grêle et des braises sont tombées.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinguruma mbinguni, na Aliye Juu Kabisa akatoa sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, mvua ya mawe na makaa ya moto.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinguruma mbinguni; Aliye Juu Kabisa alipaza sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, pamoja na mvua ya mawe na makaa yanayowaka.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinguruma kutoka angani. Mungu aliye juu ya wote alisema kwa sauti kama radi. Mvua ya mawe na makaa yanayowaka yakashuka.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tronó en los cielos, y el Altísimo dio {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz, granizo y carbones de fuego.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tronó en los cielos; el Altísimo alzó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz, con granizo y brasas ardientes.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tronó desde el cielo. El Dios que está por encima de todo habló con una voz como un trueno. Cayeron granizo y brasas ardientes.

decisions.choice: gave his voice: thundered
decisions.reason: God's voice is the thunder (29:3-9).

decisions.choice: the Most High: God above all
decisions.reason: The title ('Elyon) is explained at 7:18 and 9:3.

decisions.choice: hail and coals of fire: repeated from verse 13
decisions.reason: The last words repeat verse 13. They are not in 2 Samuel 22:14 or in the ancient Greek translation of this psalm, and may have been copied by mistake from the line above. They are in the Hebrew text and are kept.

decisions.choice: The God who is above all
decisions.reason: As in 7:18.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח חִ֭צָּיו וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם וּבְרָקִ֥ים רָ֝ב וַיְהֻמֵּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he sent his arrows and scattered them, and lightnings he shot and routed them.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arrows and scattered them, and shot lightnings and routed them.
en.B: He let {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arrows fly and scattered the enemy; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} hurled lightning bolts and threw them into confusion.
en.R: He shot {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arrows and made the enemy run away. He threw lightning at them and they did not know where to go.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a lancé {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} flèches et les a dispersés, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tiré des éclairs et les a mis en déroute.
fr.B: Il a décoché {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} flèches et dispersé l’ennemi ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a lancé des éclairs et les a jetés dans la confusion.
fr.R: Il a tiré {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} flèches et a fait fuir l’ennemi. Il a lancé des éclairs contre eux, et ils ne savaient plus où aller.

sw.L: Akatuma mishale {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} akawatawanya, na akapiga umeme akawafadhaisha.
sw.B: Aliiachilia mishale {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} akawatawanya adui; alivurumisha radi akawachanganya.
sw.R: Alipiga mishale {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} akawafanya adui wakimbie. Aliwatupia umeme, nao hawakujua waende wapi.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} envió {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} flechas y los dispersó, y lanzó relámpagos y los puso en fuga.
es.B: Disparó {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} flechas y dispersó a los enemigos; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lanzó relámpagos y los llenó de confusión.
es.R: Disparó {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} flechas e hizo huir al enemigo. Les lanzó relámpagos, y no sabían adónde ir.

decisions.choice: his arrows: lightning
decisions.reason: The lightning bolts are God's arrows (77:18; Habakkuk 3:11).

decisions.choice: routed them: threw them into panic
decisions.reason: The verb (hamam) is used of God throwing an army into confusion (Exodus 14:24; Joshua 10:10).

decisions.choice: the enemy
decisions.reason: "Them" are David's enemies; Balanced and Readable say so.

source.text: וַיֵּ֤רָא֨וּ׀אֲפִ֥יקֵי מַ֗יִם וַֽיִּגָּלוּ֮ מוֹסְד֪וֹת תֵּ֫בֵ֥ל מִגַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝נִּשְׁמַ֗ת ר֣וּחַ אַפֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And were seen [the] channels of water, and were uncovered [the] foundations of [the] world, at your rebuke, YHWH, at [the] blast of [the] breath of your nose.

en.L: And the channels of the waters appeared, and the foundations of the world were laid bare at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rebuke, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, at the blast of the breath of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} nostrils.
en.B: The beds of the sea came into view, and the world's foundations lay bare at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rebuke, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, at the blast of breath from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} nostrils.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} shouted in anger and breathed out hard, the water was pushed back. The bottom of the sea and the deep roots of the earth could be seen.

fr.L: Et les lits des eaux sont apparus, et les fondements du monde ont été mis à nu, à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} menace, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, au souffle du vent de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} narines.
fr.B: Le fond de la mer est apparu, et les fondations du monde ont été mises à nu à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} menace, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, au souffle puissant de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} narines.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as crié de colère et soufflé très fort, l’eau a été repoussée. On a pu voir le fond de la mer et les racines profondes de la terre.

sw.L: Na mifereji ya maji ikaonekana, na misingi ya ulimwengu ikawa wazi kwa kukemea {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa pumzi ya puani {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}}.
sw.B: Vitanda vya bahari vikaonekana, na misingi ya dunia ikawa wazi kwa karipio {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa mvumo wa pumzi kutoka puani {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ulipopiga kelele kwa hasira na kupumua kwa nguvu, maji yalisukumwa nyuma. Sakafu ya bahari na mizizi ya ndani ya dunia vikaonekana.

es.L: Y aparecieron los cauces de las aguas, y quedaron al descubierto los cimientos del mundo ante {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} reprensión, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ante el soplo del aliento de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nariz.
es.B: Se vio el lecho del mar, y los cimientos del mundo quedaron al desnudo ante {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} reprensión, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ante el soplo de aliento de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nariz.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} gritaste con enojo y soplaste con fuerza, el agua fue empujada hacia atrás. Se podía ver el fondo del mar y las raíces profundas de la tierra.

decisions.choice: the blast of your nostrils: as at the Red Sea
decisions.reason: At the sea "by the blast of your nostrils the waters piled up" (Exodus 15:8), and the seabed was laid bare. The rescue of David is told like the rescue at the sea.

decisions.choice: rebuke: a stern command
decisions.reason: God's rebuke (ge'arah) drives back the waters (104:7).

decisions.choice: your rebuke: the song speaks to God
decisions.reason: The song turns for a moment from "he" to "you"; 2 Samuel 22:16 keeps "his".

source.text: יִשְׁלַ֣ח מִ֭מָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽ֝מְשֵׁ֗נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: He sent from on high, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

en.L: He reached down from on high, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} took me; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} drew me out of many waters.
en.B: From on high {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stretched out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand and seized me; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} pulled me out of deep waters.
en.R: He reached down from heaven and grabbed me. He pulled me out of the deep water.

fr.L: Il a tendu [la main] d’en haut, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a pris ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a retiré des grandes eaux.
fr.B: D’en haut, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tendu {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main et m’a saisi ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a tiré des eaux profondes.
fr.R: Du ciel, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tendu la main et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a attrapé. Il m’a sorti de l’eau profonde.

sw.L: Alituma kutoka juu, akanichukua; akanitoa katika maji mengi.
sw.B: Kutoka juu alinyoosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} akanishika; akanivuta kutoka katika maji makuu.
sw.R: Alinyoosha mkono kutoka mbinguni akanishika. Akanivuta kutoka katika maji mengi.

es.L: Extendió [la mano] desde lo alto, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me tomó; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me sacó de las muchas aguas.
es.B: Desde lo alto {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} extendió {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano y me agarró; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me sacó de las aguas profundas.
es.R: Bajó la mano desde el cielo y me agarró. Me sacó del agua profunda.

decisions.choice: drew me out: the verb of Moses' name
decisions.reason: The verb (mashah) is found only here, in 2 Samuel 22:17 and in Exodus 2:10, where Pharaoh's daughter names Moses because she "drew him out" of the water.

decisions.choice: many waters: the floods of death and danger
decisions.reason: The waters of verse 5; many waters are the forces of chaos and death (32:6; 144:7).

decisions.choice: he sent: he reached out his hand
decisions.reason: "He sent" is short for "he sent out his hand" (144:7).

source.text: יַצִּילֵ֗נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֥י עָ֑ז וּ֝מִשֹּׂנְאַ֗י כִּֽי־אָמְצ֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: He rescued me from my enemy, strong, and from those who hated me, for they were stronger than I.

en.L: He rescued me from my strong enemy and from those who hated me, for they were too strong for me.
en.B: He snatched me away from my powerful enemy, from those who hated me, because they were stronger than I was.
en.R: He saved me from my powerful enemy and from all who hated me. They were too strong for me to fight.

fr.L: Il m’a délivré de mon ennemi puissant et de ceux qui me haïssaient, car ils étaient trop forts pour moi.
fr.B: Il m’a arraché à mon puissant ennemi, à ceux qui me haïssaient, parce qu’ils étaient plus forts que moi.
fr.R: Il m’a sauvé de mon ennemi puissant et de tous ceux qui me haïssaient. Ils étaient trop forts pour que je les combatte.

sw.L: Aliniokoa kutoka kwa adui yangu mwenye nguvu, na kutoka kwa wale walionichukia, kwa maana walikuwa na nguvu kuliko mimi.
sw.B: Alininyakua kutoka kwa adui yangu mwenye nguvu, kutoka kwa wale walionichukia, kwa sababu walinizidi nguvu.
sw.R: Aliniokoa kutoka kwa adui yangu mwenye nguvu na kutoka kwa wote walionichukia. Walikuwa na nguvu mno kwangu kupigana nao.

es.L: Me libró de mi enemigo poderoso y de los que me odiaban, porque eran más fuertes que yo.
es.B: Me arrebató de mi enemigo poderoso, de los que me odiaban, porque eran más fuertes que yo.
es.R: Me salvó de mi enemigo poderoso y de todos los que me odiaban. Eran demasiado fuertes para que yo pudiera pelear con ellos.

decisions.choice: my strong enemy: one enemy above all
decisions.reason: The singular "enemy" may be Saul (verse 1) or every enemy taken together.

decisions.choice: they were too strong for me: rescue by God alone
decisions.reason: David does not boast of his own strength; the rescue is God's work.

source.text: יְקַדְּמ֥וּנִי בְיוֹם־אֵידִ֑י וַֽיְהִי־יְהוָ֖ה לְמִשְׁעָ֣ן לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: They confronted me in [the] day of my calamity, but YHWH became a support to me.

en.L: They confronted me in the day of my calamity, but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} became a support to me.
en.B: They came at me on my day of disaster, but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} held me up.
en.R: They attacked me when I was in deep trouble. But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} took care of me.

fr.L: Ils m’ont affronté au jour de mon malheur, mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a été pour moi un appui.
fr.B: Ils sont venus contre moi au jour de mon désastre, mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a soutenu.
fr.R: Ils m’ont attaqué quand j’étais dans un grand malheur. Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a pris soin de moi.

sw.L: Walinikabili siku ya msiba wangu, lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawa tegemeo langu.
sw.B: Walinijia siku ya msiba wangu, lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinishika.
sw.R: Walinishambulia nilipokuwa katika taabu kubwa. Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinitunza.

es.L: Me salieron al encuentro en el día de mi desgracia, pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} fue mi apoyo.
es.B: Me atacaron en mi día de desastre, pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me sostuvo.
es.R: Me atacaron cuando yo estaba en grandes problemas. Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me cuidó.

decisions.choice: calamity: ruin, disaster
decisions.reason: The word ('ed) is a crushing disaster (Proverbs 1:26-27).

decisions.choice: support: a staff to lean on
decisions.reason: The word (mish'an) is something to lean on, like a staff (23:4 uses a related word).

source.text: וַיּוֹצִיאֵ֥נִי לַמֶּרְחָ֑ב יְ֝חַלְּצֵ֗נִי כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And he brought me out to the broad place; he rescued me, for he delighted in me.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brought me out into the broad place; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rescued me, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} delighted in me.
en.B: He led me out into open country; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} set me free, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was pleased with me.
en.R: He brought me out to a safe, open place. He saved me because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was happy with me.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a fait sortir au large ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a délivré, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prenait plaisir en moi.
fr.B: Il m’a conduit en terrain dégagé ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a libéré, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’aimait.
fr.R: Il m’a conduit dans un endroit sûr et ouvert. Il m’a sauvé parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était content de moi.

sw.L: Akanitoa nje mpaka mahali palipo wazi; akaniokoa, kwa maana alipendezwa nami.
sw.B: Aliniongoza nje mpaka nchi iliyo wazi; aliniweka huru, kwa sababu alipendezwa nami.
sw.R: Alinitoa mpaka mahali salama palipo wazi. Aliniokoa kwa sababu alifurahishwa nami.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me sacó a un lugar espacioso; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me libró, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se agradó de mí.
es.B: Me llevó a campo abierto; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me liberó, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estaba contento conmigo.
es.R: Me sacó a un lugar abierto y seguro. Me salvó porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estaba contento conmigo.

decisions.choice: the broad place: freedom and safety
decisions.reason: Trouble in Hebrew is a narrow place where one is hemmed in; rescue is room to move (4:2; 118:5).

decisions.choice: he delighted in me: he was pleased with me
decisions.reason: The verb (chafets) is used of God's pleasure in a person (22:9; 2 Samuel 15:26).

source.text: יִגְמְלֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה כְּצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to [the] cleanness of my hands he repaid me.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} repaid me.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} treated me as my right conduct deserved; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rewarded me because my hands were clean.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was good to me because I did what was right. I had not done wrong, so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} blessed me.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a traité selon ma justice ; selon la pureté de mes mains {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a rendu.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a traité comme le méritait ma droiture ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a récompensé parce que mes mains étaient pures.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a été bon pour moi parce que j’ai fait ce qui est juste. Je n’avais pas fait le mal, alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a béni.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinitendea kwa kadiri ya haki yangu; kwa kadiri ya usafi wa mikono yangu alinilipa.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinitendea kama mwenendo wangu wa haki ulivyostahili; alinilipa kwa sababu mikono yangu ilikuwa safi.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinitendea mema kwa sababu nilitenda yaliyo haki. Sikuwa nimetenda kosa, kwa hiyo alinibariki.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me trató conforme a mi justicia; conforme a la limpieza de mis manos {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me recompensó.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me trató como merecía mi buena conducta; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me recompensó porque mis manos estaban limpias.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} fue bueno conmigo porque hice lo correcto. Yo no había hecho nada malo, así que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me bendijo.

decisions.choice: according to my righteousness: loyalty, not sinlessness
decisions.reason: David is not claiming that he never sinned. In the setting of the title he means that he stayed loyal to the LORD and did not take matters into his own hands; he twice spared Saul's life (1 Samuel 24 and 26). The same words close this section in verse 25.

decisions.choice: cleanness of my hands: innocence in what I have done
decisions.reason: Clean hands are hands that have done no wrong (24:4).

decisions.choice: dealt with me: repaid me
decisions.reason: As in 13:6.

source.text: כִּֽי־שָׁ֭מַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־רָ֝שַׁ֗עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: For I have kept [the] ways of YHWH and have not acted wickedly from my God.

en.L: For I have kept the ways of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and I have not acted wickedly [to depart] from my God.
en.B: For I have walked in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s ways and have not turned from my God to do evil.
en.R: I have obeyed {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I have not turned away from my God to do evil.

fr.L: Car j’ai gardé les chemins {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et je n’ai pas agi méchamment [en m’éloignant] de mon Dieu.
fr.B: Car j’ai suivi les chemins {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et je ne me suis pas détourné de mon Dieu pour faire le mal.
fr.R: J’ai obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Je ne me suis pas éloigné de mon Dieu pour faire le mal.

sw.L: Kwa maana nimezishika njia za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wala sikutenda uovu [kwa kumwacha] Mungu wangu.
sw.B: Kwa maana nimeenenda katika njia za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wala sikumwacha Mungu wangu ili kutenda mabaya.
sw.R: Nimemtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Sijamwacha Mungu wangu ili kutenda maovu.

es.L: Porque he guardado los caminos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y no me he apartado impíamente de mi Dios.
es.B: Porque he andado en los caminos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y no me he alejado de mi Dios para hacer el mal.
es.R: He obedecido {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. No me he apartado de mi Dios para hacer lo malo.

decisions.choice: acted wickedly from my God: left God to do wrong
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins "act wickedly" and "from": to sin by leaving God.

decisions.choice: kept the ways of the LORD: lived as he commands
decisions.reason: The LORD's ways are the life he has commanded (Deuteronomy 8:6).

source.text: כִּ֣י כָל־מִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְ֝חֻקֹּתָ֗יו לֹא־אָסִ֥יר מֶֽנִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: For all his judgments [are] before me, and his statutes I have not turned aside from me.

en.L: For all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} judgments [are] before me, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes I have not turned aside from me.
en.B: All {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rulings have been in front of me; I have not pushed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} laws aside.
en.R: I keep all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} laws in mind. I have not stopped obeying {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rules.

fr.L: Car tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} jugements [sont] devant moi, et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions, je ne les ai pas écartées de moi.
fr.B: Toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} décisions sont restées devant moi ; je n’ai pas mis de côté {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois.
fr.R: Je garde toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois en tête. Je n’ai pas cessé d’obéir à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} règles.

sw.L: Kwa maana hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote [ziko] mbele yangu, na kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} sikuziweka mbali nami.
sw.B: Maamuzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yote yamekuwa mbele yangu; sikuzisukuma kando sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.R: Ninazikumbuka sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote. Sijaacha kuzitii amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.

es.L: Porque todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} juicios [están] delante de mí, y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos no he apartado de mí.
es.B: Todas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} normas han estado delante de mí; no he hecho a un lado {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} leyes.
es.R: Tengo presentes todas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} leyes. No he dejado de obedecer {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} normas.

decisions.choice: judgments, statutes: God's commands
decisions.reason: Two common words for God's law (Deuteronomy 4:1, 8).

decisions.choice: before me: always in view
decisions.reason: To keep the law before one's eyes is to live by it (16:8).

source.text: וָאֱהִ֣י תָמִ֣ים עִמּ֑וֹ וָ֝אֶשְׁתַּמֵּ֗ר מֵעֲוֺנִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And I was blameless with him, and I kept myself from my iniquity.

en.L: And I was blameless with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and I kept myself from my iniquity.
en.B: I was whole-hearted with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; I guarded myself from sin.
en.R: I was loyal to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with all my heart. I kept myself from doing wrong.

fr.L: Et j’ai été intègre envers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et je me suis gardé de ma faute.
fr.B: J’ai été d’un cœur entier avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; je me suis gardé du péché.
fr.R: Je {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ai été fidèle de tout mon cœur. Je me suis gardé de faire le mal.

sw.L: Nami nilikuwa mkamilifu pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, nikajilinda na uovu wangu.
sw.B: Nilikuwa mwaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} kwa moyo wote; nilijilinda nisitende dhambi.
sw.R: Nilikuwa mwaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} kwa moyo wangu wote. Nilijizuia nisitende mabaya.

es.L: Y fui íntegro con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, y me guardé de mi iniquidad.
es.B: He sido de corazón entero con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; me he cuidado del pecado.
es.R: Le he sido leal a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} con todo mi corazón. Me he cuidado de hacer el mal.

decisions.choice: blameless: whole, with integrity
decisions.reason: As in 15:2.

decisions.choice: from my iniquity: from sinning
decisions.reason: "My iniquity" is the sin he might have committed; he kept himself from it.

source.text: וַיָּֽשֶׁב־יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣י כְצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And YHWH repaid me according to my righteousness, according to [the] cleanness of my hands before his eyes.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eyes.
en.B: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rewarded me for doing right, for the clean hands {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} could see.
en.R: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rewarded me because I did what was right. He saw that I had not done wrong.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a rendu selon ma justice, selon la pureté de mes mains devant {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} yeux.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a récompensé de ma droiture, de la pureté de mes mains qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pouvait voir.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a récompensé parce que j’ai fait ce qui est juste. Il a vu que je n’avais pas fait le mal.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenilipa kwa kadiri ya haki yangu, kwa kadiri ya usafi wa mikono yangu mbele ya macho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinilipa kwa kutenda haki, kwa mikono safi aliyoiona.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinituza kwa sababu nilitenda yaliyo haki. Aliona kwamba sikuwa nimetenda kosa.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha recompensado conforme a mi justicia, conforme a la limpieza de mis manos delante de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos.
es.B: Así que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me recompensó por hacer lo correcto, por las manos limpias que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} podía ver.
es.R: Así que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me recompensó porque hice lo correcto. Vio que yo no había hecho nada malo.

decisions.choice: repaid me according to my righteousness: verse 21 again
decisions.reason: The words of verse 21 return, closing this part of the song.

decisions.choice: before his eyes: as God sees it
decisions.reason: The cleanness is what God himself sees, not only what others see.

source.text: עִם־חָסִ֥יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם־גְּבַ֥ר תָּ֝מִ֗ים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: With [the] loyal you show yourself loyal; with [the] blameless man you show yourself blameless.

en.L: With the loyal {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} show {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} loyal; with the blameless {{gender:person|man}} {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} show {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} blameless.
en.B: To the faithful {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are faithful; to those of integrity {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} show integrity.
en.R: You keep faith with people who keep faith with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. You are good to people who live good lives.

fr.L: Avec le fidèle {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} montres fidèle ; avec {{gender:la personne|l’homme}} intègre {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} montres intègre.
fr.B: Avec celui qui est fidèle, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fidèle ; avec ceux qui sont intègres, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} agis avec intégrité.
fr.R: Tu restes fidèle envers ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} restent fidèles. Tu es bon pour ceux qui mènent une vie droite.

sw.L: Kwa mwaminifu unajionyesha mwaminifu; kwa mtu mkamilifu unajionyesha mkamilifu.
sw.B: Kwa waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mwaminifu; kwa wenye unyofu unaonyesha unyofu.
sw.R: Unawaonyesha uaminifu watu walio waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}. Unawatendea mema watu wanaoishi maisha mema.

es.L: Con el leal {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} muestras leal; con {{gender:la persona íntegra|el hombre íntegro}} {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} muestras íntegro.
es.B: Con el fiel {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres fiel; con los íntegros {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} actúas con integridad.
es.R: Tú eres fiel con los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} son fieles. Tú eres bueno con los que viven una vida buena.

decisions.choice: you show yourself loyal: God answers people as they are
decisions.reason: Verses 26-27 state the rule behind verses 21-25: God deals with each person in keeping with how that person lives toward him.

decisions.choice: the loyal: one who keeps faith
decisions.reason: The word (chasid) is the one of 4:4 and 16:10.

decisions.choice: person, with "man" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The word (gever) means a man, but here anyone who lives this way.

source.text: עִם־נָבָ֥ר תִּתְבָּרָ֑ר וְעִם־עִ֝קֵּ֗שׁ תִּתְפַּתָּֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: With [the one who] purifies himself you show yourself pure, but with [the] crooked you show yourself twisted.

en.L: With the pure {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} show {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} pure, but with the crooked {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} show {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} shrewd.
en.B: To the pure {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} prove {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} pure, but with the crooked {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are subtle.
en.R: You are pure with people who are pure. But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are clever with people who are twisted and false.

fr.L: Avec le pur {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} montres pur, mais avec le tortueux {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} montres habile.
fr.B: Avec le pur, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} montres pur, mais avec l’homme tortueux {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es plein de ruse.
fr.R: Tu es pur avec ceux qui sont purs. Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es plus malin que ceux qui sont tordus et faux.

sw.L: Kwa aliye safi unajionyesha safi, lakini kwa mpotovu unajionyesha mwerevu.
sw.B: Kwa walio safi unajithibitisha kuwa safi, lakini kwa wapotovu unatenda kwa werevu.
sw.R: Wewe ni safi kwa watu walio safi. Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mwerevu kuliko watu wapotovu na waongo.

es.L: Con el puro {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} muestras puro, pero con el torcido {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} muestras astuto.
es.B: Con el puro {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} muestras puro, pero con el retorcido {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres sagaz.
es.R: Tú eres puro con los que son puros. Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres más listo que los que son retorcidos y falsos.

decisions.choice: with the crooked you are shrewd: God outwits them
decisions.reason: The verb (patal, to twist) is a different word from "crooked" ('iqqesh). God does not become crooked; he matches the schemes of the crooked and turns them back on them (Proverbs 3:34).

decisions.choice: the pure: one who keeps himself clean
decisions.reason: The form means one who purifies himself, keeping his life clean.

source.text: כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה עַם־עָנִ֣י תוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינַ֖יִם רָמ֣וֹת תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃

records.literal_gloss: For you save an afflicted people, but haughty eyes you bring low.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} save an afflicted people, but haughty eyes {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} bring low.
en.B: You rescue people who are humbled, but proud eyes {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} bring down.
en.R: You save people who are poor and humble. But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} bring down people who are proud.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sauves un peuple humble, mais les yeux hautains, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les abaisses.
fr.B: Tu sauves les gens humiliés, mais les regards orgueilleux, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les fais baisser.
fr.R: Tu sauves les gens pauvres et humbles. Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais tomber ceux qui sont orgueilleux.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unawaokoa watu wanyonge, lakini macho ya kiburi unayashusha.
sw.B: Unawaokoa watu walionyenyekezwa, lakini macho ya kiburi unayashusha chini.
sw.R: Unawaokoa watu walio maskini na wanyenyekevu. Lakini unawashusha watu wenye kiburi.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} salvas al pueblo afligido, pero los ojos altivos {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} los humillas.
es.B: Tú rescatas a la gente humillada, pero a los ojos orgullosos {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} los abates.
es.R: Tú salvas a los pobres y humildes. Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} derribas a los orgullosos.

decisions.choice: afflicted: poor, humbled
decisions.reason: The word ('ani) means poor and pressed down, and so dependent on God (9:13).

decisions.choice: haughty eyes: pride
decisions.reason: Eyes raised high look down on others (101:5; Proverbs 6:17).

source.text: כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה תָּאִ֣יר נֵרִ֑י יְהוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: For you light my lamp; YHWH my God makes bright my darkness.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} light my lamp; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God makes my darkness bright.
en.B: You make my lamp shine; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God brightens my darkness.
en.R: You give me light like a lamp. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} my God makes my dark times bright.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} allumes ma lampe ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu éclaire mes ténèbres.
fr.B: Tu fais briller ma lampe ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu illumine mon obscurité.
fr.R: Tu me donnes de la lumière comme une lampe. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu éclaire mes moments sombres.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unaiwasha taa yangu; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu analifanya giza langu kuwa nuru.
sw.B: Unaifanya taa yangu iwake; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu analiangaza giza langu.
sw.R: Unanipa nuru kama taa. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu anazigeuza nyakati zangu za giza kuwa nuru.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} enciendes mi lámpara; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mi Dios alumbra mis tinieblas.
es.B: Tú haces brillar mi lámpara; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mi Dios ilumina mi oscuridad.
es.R: Tú me das luz como una lámpara. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mi Dios hace que mis tiempos oscuros se llenen de luz.

decisions.choice: my lamp: my life and its future
decisions.reason: A burning lamp is a picture of life and hope; the lamp of the wicked goes out (Job 18:6). God keeps David's lamp burning.

decisions.choice: you ... the LORD: the song moves between "you" and "he"
decisions.reason: The line speaks to God and then of him, as songs of praise often do.

source.text: כִּֽי־בְ֭ךָ אָרֻ֣ץ גְּד֑וּד וּ֝בֵֽאלֹהַ֗י אֲדַלֶּג־שֽׁוּר׃

records.literal_gloss: For by you I run [against] a troop, and by my God I leap over a wall.

en.L: For by {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I run [against] a troop, and by my God I leap over a wall.
en.B: With {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I can rush an armed band; by the strength of my God I can vault a wall.
en.R: With {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} help I can attack a whole army. With God's help I can jump over a city wall.

fr.L: Car avec {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} je cours [contre] une troupe, et avec mon Dieu je franchis une muraille.
fr.B: Avec {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, je peux foncer sur une bande armée ; par la force de mon Dieu, je peux sauter par-dessus un mur.
fr.R: Avec {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} aide, je peux attaquer toute une armée. Avec l’aide de Dieu, je peux sauter par-dessus le mur d’une ville.

sw.L: Kwa maana pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} ninashambulia kikosi, na kwa Mungu wangu ninaruka ukuta.
sw.B: Pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} ninaweza kukivamia kikosi cha askari; kwa nguvu za Mungu wangu ninaweza kuruka ukuta.
sw.R: Kwa msaada {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ninaweza kushambulia jeshi zima. Kwa msaada wa Mungu ninaweza kuruka ukuta wa mji.

es.L: Porque contigo corro [contra] una tropa, y con mi Dios salto un muro.
es.B: Contigo puedo lanzarme contra una banda armada; con la fuerza de mi Dios puedo saltar una muralla.
es.R: Con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ayuda puedo atacar a todo un ejército. Con la ayuda de Dios puedo saltar el muro de una ciudad.

decisions.choice: a troop: a raiding band
decisions.reason: The word (gedud) is a band of raiders (1 Samuel 30:8). The verb may mean "run" or, read slightly differently, "crush".

decisions.choice: leap over a wall: storm a city
decisions.reason: A wall is a city wall; with God's help David takes walled cities (2 Samuel 5:6-7).

decisions.choice: your help
decisions.reason: Readable says that "by you" means by God's help.

source.text: הָאֵל֮ תָּמִ֪ים דַּ֫רְכּ֥וֹ אִמְרַֽת־יְהוָ֥ה צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לְכֹ֤ל׀הַחֹסִ֬ים בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: The God, blameless [is] his way; [the] word of YHWH [is] refined; a shield he [is] to all who take refuge in him.

en.L: [As for] God, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} way [is] blameless; the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] refined; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] a shield to all who take refuge in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: This is God: {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} way is without flaw; the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is tested and true; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is a shield for all who make {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} their refuge.
en.R: God always does what is right. What {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says is always true. He protects everyone who runs to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for safety.

fr.L: [Quant à] Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voie [est] intègre ; la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] éprouvée ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [est] un bouclier pour tous ceux qui se réfugient en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Voilà Dieu : {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voie est sans défaut ; la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est éprouvée et sûre ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est un bouclier pour tous ceux qui font de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} leur refuge.
fr.R: Dieu fait toujours ce qui est juste. Ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est toujours vrai. Il protège tous ceux qui courent se mettre à l’abri auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: [Kwa habari ya] Mungu, njia {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} [ni] kamilifu; neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} limesafishwa; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ni] ngao kwa wote wanaomkimbilia.
sw.B: Huyu ndiye Mungu: njia {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} haina dosari; neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} limejaribiwa na ni la kweli; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni ngao kwa wote wanaomfanya kuwa kimbilio lao.
sw.R: Mungu daima hutenda yaliyo haki. Anachosema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni kweli daima. Anamlinda kila mtu anayemkimbilia ili kupata usalama.

es.L: Dios: {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} camino [es] intachable; la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [está] probada en el fuego; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] escudo para todos los que se refugian en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Así es Dios: {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} camino no tiene falla; la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es probada y verdadera; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es escudo para todos los que hacen de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} su refugio.
es.R: Dios siempre hace lo que es justo. Lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice es siempre verdad. Él protege a todos los que corren hacia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} para estar a salvo.

decisions.choice: refined: tested and proved pure
decisions.reason: As silver is refined (12:7), God's word has been tested and found true (Proverbs 30:5).

decisions.choice: blameless: whole, without flaw
decisions.reason: The word used of David in verse 24 is used of God's way.

decisions.choice: The God: this God
decisions.reason: With the article the word points to the God the song has been describing.

source.text: כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭לוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For who [is] God except YHWH? And who [is] a rock except our God?

en.L: For who [is] God except {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? And who [is] a rock except our God?
en.B: Is there any God but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? Is there any rock but our God?
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is the only God. Only our God is strong and safe like a rock.

fr.L: Car qui [est] Dieu, sinon {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? Et qui [est] un rocher, sinon notre Dieu ?
fr.B: Y a-t-il un autre Dieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? Y a-t-il un autre rocher que notre Dieu ?
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est le seul Dieu. Seul notre Dieu est solide et sûr comme un rocher.

sw.L: Kwa maana ni nani Mungu isipokuwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Na mwamba ni nani isipokuwa Mungu wetu?
sw.B: Je, yuko Mungu mwingine ila {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Je, upo mwamba mwingine ila Mungu wetu?
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} peke yake ndiye Mungu. Mungu wetu peke yake ndiye mwenye nguvu na salama kama mwamba.

es.L: Porque ¿quién [es] Dios fuera {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? ¿Y quién [es] roca fuera de nuestro Dios?
es.B: ¿Hay algún Dios aparte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? ¿Hay alguna roca aparte de nuestro Dios?
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es el único Dios. Solo nuestro Dios es fuerte y seguro como una roca.

decisions.choice: who is God except the LORD?: there is none
decisions.reason: The questions expect the answer "no one" (Isaiah 44:8).

decisions.choice: God: Eloah
decisions.reason: The word here is 'Eloah, a poetic form of the word for God.

decisions.choice: statements
decisions.reason: Readable turns the questions into what they mean (m1).

source.text: הָ֭אֵל הַמְאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חָ֑יִל וַיִּתֵּ֖ן תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: The God who girds me [with] strength and has made blameless my way,

en.L: The God who girds me [with] strength and has made my way blameless,
en.B: the God who straps strength around me like a belt and makes my way secure,
en.R: God makes me strong. He keeps me safe wherever I go.

fr.L: Le Dieu qui me ceint [de] force et qui a rendu ma voie intègre,
fr.B: le Dieu qui attache la force autour de moi comme une ceinture et qui rend mon chemin sûr,
fr.R: Dieu me rend fort. Il me garde en sécurité partout où je vais.

sw.L: Mungu anayenifunga [kwa] nguvu na ameifanya njia yangu kuwa kamilifu,
sw.B: Mungu anayenifunga nguvu kiunoni kama mshipi na kuifanya njia yangu iwe salama,
sw.R: Mungu hunipa nguvu. Ananilinda salama kila ninapokwenda.

es.L: El Dios que me ciñe [de] fuerza y ha hecho perfecto mi camino,
es.B: el Dios que me ciñe de fuerza como con un cinturón y hace seguro mi camino,
es.R: Dios me hace fuerte. Él me mantiene a salvo dondequiera que voy.

decisions.choice: girds me with strength: gives me strength
decisions.reason: A soldier tied his belt tight before battle; God fastens strength on David like a belt (verse 40; 1 Samuel 2:4).

decisions.choice: made my way blameless: kept my path safe and whole
decisions.reason: The word (tamim) here means whole or unbroken: a road with no stumbling.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The description of God continues through verse 35, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

source.text: מְשַׁוֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַי כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּ֝מֹתַ֗י יַעֲמִידֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: making my feet like the does, and on my heights he makes me stand,

en.L: making my feet like the does', and on my heights {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes me stand,
en.B: who makes my feet as sure as a deer's and sets me firm on the heights,
en.R: He makes me sure-footed like a deer. He lets me stand safely high up in the mountains.

fr.L: rendant mes pieds comme [ceux] des biches, et sur mes hauteurs {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me fait tenir debout,
fr.B: qui rend mes pieds aussi sûrs que ceux d’une biche et me fait tenir ferme sur les hauteurs,
fr.R: Il me donne le pied sûr comme une biche. Il me fait tenir solidement tout en haut des montagnes.

sw.L: anayeifanya miguu yangu kama ya kulungu jike, na juu ya mahali pangu pa juu ananisimamisha,
sw.B: anayeifanya miguu yangu kuwa imara kama ya ayala na kunisimamisha imara juu ya vilele,
sw.R: Ananifanya niwe na miguu imara kama ya ayala. Ananiruhusu nisimame salama juu milimani.

es.L: que hace mis pies como [los] de las ciervas, y en mis alturas {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me hace estar firme,
es.B: que hace mis pies tan seguros como los del ciervo y me afirma en las alturas,
es.R: Me hace caminar seguro como un ciervo. Me deja estar a salvo en lo alto de las montañas.

decisions.choice: like the does: sure-footed on the rocks
decisions.reason: Deer move swiftly and safely on steep crags (Habakkuk 3:19).

decisions.choice: my heights: the high ground
decisions.reason: To stand on the heights is to hold the high ground, safe and in command (Deuteronomy 32:13).

source.text: מְלַמֵּ֣ד יָ֭דַי לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְֽנִחֲתָ֥ה קֶֽשֶׁת־נְ֝חוּשָׁ֗ה זְרוֹעֹתָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: training my hands for the battle, and bends a bow of bronze my arms.

en.L: training my hands for battle, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
en.B: who trains my hands for war, so that my arms can draw a bronze bow.
en.R: He trains me to fight in battle. He makes my arms strong enough to bend a bow made of bronze.

fr.L: exerçant mes mains au combat, en sorte que mes bras tendent un arc de bronze.
fr.B: qui exerce mes mains à la guerre, si bien que mes bras peuvent bander un arc de bronze.
fr.R: Il m’apprend à combattre dans la bataille. Il rend mes bras assez forts pour tendre un arc de bronze.

sw.L: anayeifundisha mikono yangu kwa vita, hata mikono yangu inaweza kupinda upinde wa shaba.
sw.B: anayeifundisha mikono yangu vita, hata mikono yangu inaweza kuuvuta upinde wa shaba.
sw.R: Ananifundisha kupigana vitani. Anaifanya mikono yangu iwe na nguvu za kutosha kupinda upinde uliotengenezwa kwa shaba.
